fields.Name: MJ Canon
fields.Description: Governed institutional semantic graph connecting business concepts, canonical Alternate Base Views, approved Queries, and entity schema relationships.

fields.Name: Canon Alternate Base View Edges
fields.Description: Projects MJ: Entity Alternate Base Views into Subsets edges pointing to their owning MJ: Entities and parent views.

fields.Name: Canon Query Metadata Edges
fields.Description: Projects MJ: Query Entities (including AlternateBaseViewID) into Reads edges and MJ: Query Dependencies into Composes edges.

fields.Name: Canon Entity Metadata Edges
fields.Description: Projects MJ: Entities foreign keys into References edges, ParentID inheritance into Is A edges, and participating MJ: Entity Fields into Field Of edges.
